name: Screen Print
description: Layered spot-colour printing: 2-6 flat inks that overprint into new colours, bold shapes, halftone tone areas and characteristic mis-registration and ink texture.
visual_characteristics: a strict ink budget (2-6 spot colours) with visible overprint intersections
bold, high-contrast graphic shapes with knock-outs
slight mis-registration, ink speckle and paper showing through

palette.guidance: Choose 3-5 inks (e.g. tomato red, cobalt, mustard, black) on cream/kraft paper. Overprint areas (multiply) are pre-computed as darker mixed fills. No gradients.

geometry: Simplified poster shapes, thick contours or knock-outs, strong silhouettes; geometric reduction; text and image built from the same blocky shapes.
stroke: Prefer shape-based; if lines are used they are thick and blunt (butt/round) and belong to one ink layer.
texture: Halftone dots (<pattern>), speckled ink dropout (single feTurbulence mask on one ink layer), slight paper grain.
composition: Poster: dominant central image, bold title; asymmetric balance; margins consistent; overprint moments used deliberately at overlaps.
typography: Bold display type, often integrated with the image; each letter in a single ink or knocked out of a shape.
lighting_depth: Graphic light through ink values and overprints; no gradients; depth by layered opacity multiplication simulated with explicit mixed colours.
svg_techniques: one <g id="ink-red"> etc. per ink layer; layer offsets of 0.5-1.5 units for mis-registration
explicit overprint shapes: duplicate the overlap area via clip-path and fill with the mixed colour (or use mix-blend-mode: multiply with a fallback)
halftone patterns via <pattern> sized to the print screen; different dot radii in different areas
speckle mask via feTurbulence thresholded by feComponentTransfer (only on one layer)

name: Risograph
description: Grainy two-to-three-ink duplicator prints: fluorescent inks with overprint, coarse halftone/grain shading, gentle mis-registration and matte uncoated paper.
visual_characteristics: 2-3 vivid inks (fluorescent pink, riso blue, sunflower yellow, teal) overprinting
coarse grain and dot gradients instead of smooth gradients
off-register layers with visible overlap colours
matte cream paper; slightly soft, imperfect edges

palette.guidance: Riso inks: fluorescent pink #ff48b0, blue #0078bf, yellow #ffe800, teal #00a95c, orange #ff6c2f, purple #765ba7; paper #f4efe4. Use 2-3 inks; overprint = multiply mix.

geometry: Bold simple shapes, rounded and slightly irregular; grain fills; chunky lettering; strong silhouettes; layout often playful and off-grid.
stroke: Few strokes; where used, thick and round in one ink layer.
texture: Grain gradients: shapes filled with a dot/noise pattern whose density varies (via feTurbulence thresholded with feComponentTransfer, or a <pattern> at two densities); paper fibre.
composition: Layered overlapping shapes; strong colour blocking; offset duplicates for misregistration; abundant paper margin; playful asymmetry.
typography: Chunky friendly display type; overprinted letters offset by 2-3 units in the second ink.
lighting_depth: Depth via overprint colour mixing and grain density; no smooth gradients.
svg_techniques: one <g> per ink with mix-blend-mode: multiply (SVG2/CSS) AND a fallback of explicit overlap fill; offset each ink group by (1..3,1..2)
grain gradient: define filter grain (feTurbulence type=fractalNoise baseFrequency .9 -> feColorMatrix to alpha -> feComposite in SourceGraphic) applied to selected shapes only
halftone <pattern> with 2 dot sizes for graded areas
paper background off-white; no pure white

name: Graffiti / Street Art
description: Urban wall art: bold outlined lettering or characters, spray gradients and drips, stencil cutouts, arrows, stars and layered tags on textured brick or concrete.
visual_characteristics: chunky outlined lettering (bubble/wildstyle) with 3D drop-extrusions and highlights
spray-paint softness: fades, halos, drips and overspray
stencil layering: hard-edged shapes with bridges
gritty wall textures: brick, concrete, posters and tags

palette.guidance: High-saturation spray colours (hot pink, cyan, acid yellow, orange) with black and white outlines; wall in warm concrete/brick tones. Fills often have a light-to-dark fade.

geometry: Rounded, inflated letterforms with overlapping strokes; arrows and crowns; stencil bridges; dynamic diagonals; extrusion shapes.
stroke: Layered outlines: inner white highlight line, thick black outline (6-10 units), outer offset shadow; round joins. Drips = tapered vertical paths.
texture: Brick or concrete via <pattern>; spray via blurred gradient dots and speckle; grime overlay at low opacity.
composition: Piece dominates the wall; slight tilt; supporting tags/characters around; some elements overlapping the frame; energetic and asymmetrical.
typography: Draw letters as custom paths (bubbly, overlapping); avoid live text. Small tag signatures in a scrawl.
lighting_depth: Fake 3D extrusion behind letters; highlight streaks on top-left; overspray glow around edges.
svg_techniques: letters as stacked paths: extrusion (offset copy in darker tone), fill with linearGradient, black outline stroke, white inner highlight
drips as thin tapered paths with circular end blobs
spray fade via radialGradient with soft opacity stops; a single blur filter on overspray layer only
brick wall as <pattern> with mortar lines; slight colour variation via 3 brick fills
avoid: copying real artists' works or signatures
